rule: AMBUSH: a spawn group is enabled by default unless its member spawn mask is zero (ObjectMgr 1519); a script (area trigger, quest-gated) calls Spawn with forced true, which skips the enabled check. CAMP: a formation with one of seven shapes; spacing equals the model collision width times 3; each slot holds a target angle and distance and eases toward a random point in a band of pi/8 times model width; the group max-alive count caps spawns. LAIR: a link row gives each minion flags (aggro, evade, death, respawn, follow, despawn, can't-spawn-if-boss-dead 0x0400, can't-spawn-if-boss-alive 0x0800) and a search range; a map-wide link (range 0) reads the instance encounter state and the boss respawn readiness; a local link reads the master's alive state inside a squared range. ESCORT (npc_escortAI): refused in combat; starts after 2500 ms; checks every 1000 ms whether the player or group is within 66 yards; on failure the quest fails and the NPC respawns or despawns. PATROL: waypoint nodes carry a wait in ms; a single node with no wait is forced to 5000 ms; a script can change a node's wait.
